Introduction
This procedure details the minor 
 maintenance activities (1st level of maintenance as 
 indicated by the P1), which are performed from 1:2 years as indicated by the 
 Y1: 2. Routine Inspection (The Daily Check)
The first draft initiated by: eng. Saleh Abdou, tested by eng 
 Mohamed Abaas & eng Tawfeek Ramadan, revised by quality control eng. 
 Tawfeek Elabasery 
 at EDEPCo., accepted by general manager eng Tarek 
 Youssef 
 Ali and approved by eng Mechaeal George Habashy head sector of Ayoun Moussa 
 power station
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued, the qualified maintenance staff must carry the 
 suitable ID safety category,
Safety fence (rope) with caution marks surrounding the work area is required,
Wear the appropriate 
 safety equipment as safety shoes, helmet,
Reactor out of service and work permit required.
Use 
 only fiberglass ladders.
If 
 it becomes necessary to enter the main tank, be sure that the oxygen level is 
 sufficient to provide safe working conditions.
Personnel carrying out the inspection should be trained and qualified or 
 directly supervised by someone who is.

Insulating Oil

 tap-changer.
Temperature Indicator
1. Read 
 and record oil and if any winding temperature.
2. Record 
 ambient temperature, load (MW, MVAR) and voltage.
Notes:
Transformer temperature directly 
 affects the life of the insulating material.
Maximum temperature rise limits are 
 specified for the both oil and winding temperature.
In the daily 
 inspection, check not only that temperatures are held within the maximum 
 limit, but also that the temperature lies in a satisfactory range in relation 
 to their values in the test report, load condition and ambient temperature.
